summary: Configured PostgreSQL 13 streaming replication across the AlmaLinux 9 cluster: node1 as writable primary, node2 and node3 as read-only async standbys via pg_basebackup -R. Verified writes on the primary propagate to both standbys and that standbys reject writes. Completed the mandatory rolling-restart protocol (standbys first, primary last) with boot-id proof of each restart and confirmed replication/data recovery after each.
actions_performed: Installed postgresql-server/contrib (v13.23) via dnf on node1, node2, node3
Configured node1 postgresql.conf: listen_addresses='*', wal_level=replica, max_wal_senders=10, max_replication_slots=10, hot_standby=on, wal_keep_size=512, password_encryption=[REDACTED]
Added pg_hba.conf rules on node1 for replication from node2/node3 IPs with scram-sha-256
Opened firewalld postgresql service on node1
Created replicator ROLE with REPLICATION LOGIN and a SCRAM password generated via openssl on node1; fixed initial md5-vs-scram secret mismatch
Wiped node2/node3 data dirs and ran pg_basebackup -R from node1 to bootstrap both standbys (writes standby.signal + primary_conninfo automatically)
Enabled and started postgresql on all three nodes
Verified pg_is_in_recovery()=true on standbys and pg_stat_replication shows both streaming on primary
Created repl_test table, inserted a row on primary, confirmed visibility on both standbys, confirmed standbys reject INSERT (read-only)
Captured boot_id baseline on all nodes, then rebooted node2, node3, and finally node1 (primary) one at a time via systemctl reboot, backgrounded to return before disconnect
Polled each node until exec was available again and diffed boot_id to prove an actual restart occurred
After each restart, verified postgresql active, pg_is_in_recovery/state as appropriate, existing repl_test rows intact, and pg_stat_replication showing both standbys streaming to primary
Performed a final post-restart write on primary and confirmed propagation to both standbys
Shredded the temporary replication password file from /tmp on node1

evidence.requirement: node1 configured as writable primary with replication enabled
evidence.summary: node1 initialized, configured for streaming replication, replicator role created, listening on network interface with firewall opened

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 configured as read-only standbys, streaming from node1
evidence.summary: pg_basebackup -R bootstrapped both standbys with standby.signal/primary_conninfo; both show pg_is_in_recovery=true and appear streaming in pg_stat_replication on the primary

evidence.requirement: changes on primary visible on both standbys (and standbys are read-only)
evidence.summary: Row inserted on node1 visible on node2 and node3; direct INSERT attempt on node2 rejected with read-only transaction error

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot id, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id e65e6bcf and healthy replication captured; reboot acknowledged; connection timed out during restart; new boot_id 1f5926f8 proves restart; postgresql active, in-recovery, data intact, and primary shows it streaming again post-restart

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot id, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 8c28f3cd and healthy replication captured; reboot acknowledged; timeout during restart; new boot_id e8225456 proves restart; postgresql active, in-recovery, data intact, and primary shows it streaming again post-restart

evidence.requirement: node1 (primary) restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot id, recovered state and quorum/cluster health
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 54089086 and healthy primary state captured (restarted last, after both standbys were confirmed healthy); reboot acknowledged; connection errors during restart; new boot_id 512b17f4 proves restart; postgresql active, prior data intact, both standbys reconnected and streaming

evidence.requirement: full cluster functional after all three restarts (final end-to-end proof)
evidence.summary: New row inserted on primary after all restarts completed; confirmed visible on both node2 and node3
